key.name: panel-position
key.description: Which section of the top bar the indicator sits in.

key.name: panel-index
key.description: Where the indicator sits among the other items of its section; 0 is first.

key.name: quota-toggle-menu
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that opens and closes the menu. Empty means no shortcut. Named apart from other extensions' keys, since keybinding names are global in the shell.

key.name: poll-seconds
key.description: How often, in seconds, to fetch usage.

key.name: profiles
key.description: JSON array of {id, label, configDir}, one per Claude Code profile (a directory such as ~/.claude or ~/.claude-work holding its own .credentials.json).

key.name: profiles-initialized
key.summary: Whether the profile list has been seeded
key.description: Set once auto-detection has filled "profiles" for the first time, so a list emptied on purpose is not filled again.

key.name: profile-tokens
key.description: JSON object mapping a Claude profile id to the tokens of its in-app sign-in ({accessToken, refreshToken, expiresAt}), for accounts that do not use Claude Code.

key.name: openrouter-accounts
key.description: JSON array of {id, label}, one per OpenRouter account. Their API keys are kept in the keyring under the same id, never here.

key.name: agy-accounts
key.description: JSON array of {id, label, configDir}, one per Google Antigravity / Google AI subscription profile (defaults to ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli).

key.name: agy-initialized
key.summary: Whether the Antigravity account list has been seeded
key.description: Set once auto-detection has filled "agy-accounts" for the first time, so a list emptied on purpose is not filled again.

key.name: prefs-page
key.description: Set by the menu just before it opens Settings ("accounts" for the Accounts page); Settings shows that page and clears the key.
